summary: This clinical trial is testing a study drug called LY4086940 compared to a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the medicine, for weight management. The study is for adults who are overweight or have obesity and do not have type 2 diabetes. It is sponsored by Eli Lilly and Company and is currently listed as Not yet recruiting. A total of 460 participants are expected to take part in this Phase 2 study.
